claims.claim_text: Joseph C Ciras has a confirmed match to the same exact name and private identifier in the official Army merged file; a secondary OSS roster also lists him as T/4 in Greek Group VII.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army row matches both indexed name and private identifier, while the OSS roster supplies a compatible wartime grade and Greek Group VII context.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier is decisive for the Army row. The uncommon full name and T/4 roster entry independently corroborate the OSS context without exposing the identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry is dated 29 March 1943 and the roster is wartime; neither source establishes when the occupational category ended.
claims.match_notes: No civilian employer is inferred from the occupational group, and the secondary roster is not used as the sole identity evidence.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, Joseph C Ciras was classified in the broad occupational group Structural and ornamental metal workers.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-matched Army row carries code 684, decoded on the visually inspected official code list.

claims.temporal_assessment: The entry date is 29 March 1943. The record does not state the job's dates or prove it was the immediately prior role.
claims.match_notes: Occupation is not employer evidence; no organization, worksite or role detail is invented.

claims.temporal_assessment: The source establishes wartime Army service for the candidate only; it supplies no pre-OSS employment chronology.
claims.match_notes: The candidate remains private and is not used for public claims or analytics.

claims.claim_text: Caesar J Civitella has a confirmed match across the indexed private identifier, official Army entry and USSOCOM history of his Army and OSS service.

claims.match_notes: The private identifier remains masked. Postwar CIA work is not used to answer the pre-OSS question.

claims.match_notes: Ford is not mislabeled as the immediate pre-OSS affiliation. No plant, position or start date is inferred.

claims.temporal_assessment: The source explicitly gives a one-week interval between reporting to Camp Mackall and OSS screening.
